description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The release pairs MATLAB simulation scripts with datasets for the AERPAW Lake Wheeler emulation environment. It describes fixed-trajectory emulation, fixed-trajectory simulation and autonomous-trajectory simulation folders. CSV fields include time, longitude, latitude, altitude, speed, reference-signal received power, signal-to-noise ratio and data rate. The experiments compare a measurement-calibrated MATLAB simulation with the AERPAW digital twin, supporting wireless-network model calibration and trajectory studies. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Wireless digital-twin calibration and trajectory simulation. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
